title: Changed graphs and fixed bases: conditional κ = 4.09953e-5 > 2^-15
body:
Under OpenAI's base theorem and the retained analytic and fixed finite-alphabet multitape interfaces, this gives

**κ = 409953/10000000000 = 4.09953 × 10⁻⁵ > 2⁻¹⁵**, for `T(n) = O(n (log n)^(1−κ))`.

The exponent saving is **6.6006360% above #36** and **1.6202070% above #41** (`κ=4.034168124e-5`). During final verification, Rohan Arun’s #42 published the same broad fixed/alternating composition at `4.099494519e-5`; our different carrier matching gives a further **0.0008654970%** improvement. Exact lower bounds also exclude its full network at our new bit saving. These compare asymptotic exponents, not practical runtimes or global optimality.

### Construction

Compose RaD / hipotures's alternating changed DAGs from #41 with original envelope labels, both fixed `I+J` bases from #32/#35, copied centers from #36, and reversed corners/balanced assembly from #34/#37. Recompute the entire fixed profile for each changed DAG and use descending donor traversal for the actual carrier matching. The resulting local role counts are `R23=36685`, `R25=48479`; `m=575`, `W=178378409`, total child rank `102565738275`. All **4,073,300** paid endpoint corrections remain.

The full data profile is certified at the actual fixed bases for **4,073,290** source pairs. Ten failed primary-prime tests retain a conservative **47-singleton +481** fallback. No pair is discarded and modular zeros are not treated as rational zeros. Exact all-weight rank cuts prove the ordered zeros; successful modular pivots prove rational nonvanishing.

### Finite proof and verification

The independent compiler reconstructs every physical role and rational frame incidence. The complete formal dirty basis is tested in both orientations: **40,227** basis vectors at h23 and **53,079** at h25. Every auxiliary is restored. The fixed profiles reconstruct **68,462 +92,107** transition matrices with rigorous bounded-minor CRT certification. Exact rational moments reject the complete #40 and #41 networks at the new bit saving `40997/10^9`.

**`make verify` passes**, including 184 tests, the 14 focused adversarial controls, fresh graph/profile/physical-timeline/data-pair replay, and 18 historical patch checks. Both moments, all 47 strict assembly constraints and seven margins pass. Bit moment gap exceeds `2.8072e-11`; final absorption gap exceeds `1.9314e-11`.

Start with the [proof and reproduction note](https://github.com/chafreaky/integer-mult-bounds/blob/research/alternating-fixed-corners/research/copied-fixed/PROOF.md). Run `make copied-fixed-verify` or `make verify`. The branch is based on pinned #36 commit `11817ccacb564bb7f98789c20dc11d3fece207e3`; [focused changes](https://github.com/chafreaky/integer-mult-bounds/compare/11817ccacb564bb7f98789c20dc11d3fece207e3...research/alternating-fixed-corners) isolate this increment.

This remains a conditional research witness. General partial-swap compilation, balanced fixed-tape routing/parking, analytic recovery, eligible-prime/native setup and eventual thresholds require mathematical review. No Lean extension, full formal verification or external acceptance is claimed.
